 Amazon is selling Apple AirPods Pro 3 earbuds for a near-all-time low of $179 (plus 10 more fab deals)
 Also on the deals deck: An Amazon 4K Fire Stick and a cordless Dyson vacuum at their lowest prices ever, a super-useful leaf blower discounted by a whopping 65% and so much more.
 Carrie McCabe Follow Senior Writer, Deals Updated Wed, November 18, 2026 at 2:51 PM UTC Our experts independently review everything we recommend. If you buy through our links, we may earn commission.
 Add to Preferred Sources Updated Wed, November 18, 2026 at 2:51 PM UTC Our experts independently review everything we recommend. If you buy through our links, we may earn commission.
 Looking for the best deals of the day? We've gotcha covered. (Getty) The "most wonderful time of the year" approaches, but for me personally, it's also the busiest. Getting ready to host loved ones, working on my gifting list , prepping for holiday travel... it can be a little overwhelming, despite the ample good cheer with which I tackle all these to-dos. Luckily, there are more than a few helpful items that happen to be on sale right now ahead of Black Friday .
 They include the Apple AirPods Pro 3 earbuds , down to $179 (from $249), within just $10 of their lowest-ever price since their debut and perfect for gifting the music lover in your life (or just tuning out the holiday chaos). There's also the Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K to upgrade your entertainment setup for festive movie watching — right now it's just $20, a staggering near-70% off and the lowest price we've seen since its debut. And, to make cooking for a crowd a total breeze, this top-rated Crock-Pot is all the way down to $35 (from $80). But that's not all... 
 Our top deal of the day
 Getty
 Apple AirPods Pro 3 
 $179 $249 Save $70 Save Why we love it: If I were buying AirPods for the first time, the Pro 3 would be the no-brainer pick. They come with more features than you may expect given the tiny package: You're getting up to twice the noise reduction, longer battery life (up to eight hours with ANC) and bonus features like heart-rate monitoring, transparency mode and live language translation. More than 10,000 Amazon shoppers snapped up these earbuds in the past month, so calling them a customer favorite is an understatement.
 "The noise cancellation amazed me," said one shopper . "I have a window A/C unit to cool my office, and when I put these in, I thought it turned off. It took me two or three times of taking them in and out of my ear to realize the headphones were eliminating the sound."
 Want to know more? Check out our AirPods Pro 3 review .
 Why it's a great deal: This is within $10 of the lowest price we've seen for these earbuds since they debuted last fall, and only dropped lower for Prime Day. Considering it's not even Black Friday yet, this discount is a fab score for crossing any audiophile off your holiday shopping list.
 $179 at Amazon 10 more deals to shop before they're gone
 Amazon
 Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K 
 $20 $60 Save $40 Save This new Fire TV Stick 4K is very similar to the  $85 4K Max , but with 8GB of storage and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity. While it skips Wi-Fi 6E, Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos support, you still get 4K image support, the ambient experience that lets you show art when you're not watching TV and the  just-updated Fire TV Remote . All the other Fire TV features are here: access to all your streaming apps, cloud gaming with Amazon Luna and Xbox Game Pass, and Amazon's easy-to-use interface for finding your next watch.
 Great time to buy: At just $20 (from $60), it's a rare near-70% off, the lowest price we've seen since this streaming stick came out just last month.
 $20 at Amazon Amazon
 Dyson V9 Motorbar Cordless Vacuum 
 $270 $600 Save $330 Save If you've been holding out on buying a Dyson, now's the time to make your move. Amazon's just slashed the price of the new Dyson V9 Motorbar cordless stick vacuum to make this one of the best deals we've seen in ages. This sleek powerhouse proves that cleaning doesn't have to be a chore: it weighs less than five pounds, making it effortless to maneuver from room to room (and up the stairs). The Motorbar cleaner head deep cleans all floor types while detangling hair and pet fur, and it even converts to a handheld vacuum for smaller spaces, like stairwells, cars and upholstery. You'll also get up to 40 minutes of runtime on a single charge, so you can tackle your entire home without constantly juicing up.
 Great time to buy: This is the lowest price we've seen for the V9 since its debut on Amazon just a couple of months ago. 55% off is a remarkable deal on a Dyson, especially considering it's not even Black Friday yet — so now is the time to strike for a quality vac at a colossal discount.
 Psst: You can also grab it for $270  directly from Dyson .
 $270 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $270 at Target $270 at Walmart Walmart
 Crock-Pot Manual 7-qt. Slow Cooker 
 $35 $80 Save $45 Save This Crock-Pot classic puts dinner on autopilot: Prep your ingredients, set it to cook and come back to a hot meal. With a 7-quart capacity that serves 10 or more, it’s ready for your hungry Thanksgiving crew — and can keep the mashed potatoes warm while you tackle the turkey.
 Great time to buy: At just $35 (down from $80), it’s nearly 60% off at Walmart and the lowest price we're seeing across the 'net. It's a no-brainer buy you'll be glad you grabbed ahead of holiday hosting season.
 $35 at Walmart Crocs
 Crocs Classic Clogs 
 $30 $50 Save $20 Save Beloved by chefs, medical workers, gardeners and kids alike, these ubiquitous clogs are lightweight, easy to clean, quick-drying and water-friendly. They're ideal for puttering around the house (super useful in these upcoming hibernation months) and versatile enough to go with just about any casual outfit.
 Good deal: The price varies based on the style and size you choose, but you can't go wrong with this neutral hue that's marked down to just $30 — that's an impressive 40% off.
 $30 at Crocs Amazon
 Levi's Men's 505 Regular Fit Jeans 
 $28 $75 Save $47 Save Did you know 501s have been around since 1873? I was today years old when I learned that fun fact. Anyway, these button-fly jeans have serious staying power — and for that reason, they're rarely marked down this low. Price varies depending on the wash you choose, but honestly, you can't go wrong.
 Said this loooong-time fan : "They are the blueprint for what jeans should be. I've been wearing [501s] for 50 years, and they remain as reliable, durable and comfortable as ever. No gimmicks, no stretch, just tough denim that wears in, not out." Get this guy a copywriting gig, stat!
 Great time to buy: This over-60%-off price cut is a truly remarkable discount on a No. 1 bestseller, especially one from such a popular brand. The ladies aren't missing out on the savings, either — Levi's classic straight jeans are a similarly spectacular 65% off right now as well.
 $28 at Amazon Laura Geller
 Laura Geller Baked Balance-n-Brighten Color Correcting Foundation 
 $17 $38 Save $21   at checkout Save This iconic bronzing powder, specifically designed for mature skin, contains color-correcting pigments to help even out your skin while leaving you looking natural, not like you've slathered on a ton of product. The formula self-adjusts to match your skin tone, so you don't have to worry about it being too warm or too cool as long as you select your closest shade. The product itself is actually, truly baked: The pigments are heated on terracotta tiles for 24 hours, giving them a unique consistency that offers the convenience of a powder with the coverage of a cream. They fill in pores and create a smooth finish but won't settle into fine lines.
 "This is what sold me on powder foundation, and I will be stocking up," said our resident beauty expert Marie Lodi of this popular pick. "It's the prettiest foundation I've ever seen... It's no surprise that celebs love it, and it's a winner in our list of the best foundations ."
 Great time to buy: Laura Geller's baked powder has a devoted following for a good reason — and at just $17, a 50% discount at checkout, it's your turn to see why.
 Save $21   at checkout $17 at Laura Geller Walmart
 Cate & Chloe Bianca 18-Karat White Gold Plated Hoop Earrings 
 $13 $27 Save $14 Save Hoops are a style staple, and these earrings certainly look way more expensive than they are, with 18-karat white gold plating and dazzling Swarovski crystals. They're hypoallergenic and contain no lead or nickel, so they won't cause problems for sensitive skin. Not a hoops person? There are a plethora of other Cate & Chloe styles on sale too, including these lovely studs , also just $13.
 Great time to buy: We've never seen these pretty picks priced lower than this, and, psst — they'll make a fabulous stocking stuffer for the bling-lover in your life.
 $13 at Walmart HSN
 Chef Alex Guarnaschelli Stainless Steel Cleaver with Sheath, 5" 
 $20 $25 Save $5 Save If your knives aren't slicing and dicing quite like they used to, you may need to replace them. It may seem counterintuitive, but cutting with a dull blade is actually more dangerous than with a sharp one, as it won't "bite" into the food as it should and could slip more easily. Guarnaschelli's take on an all-purpose knife features a wide, strong steel blade like a cleaver but handles like a slimmer chef's knife. It comes with a sheath and is dishwasher-safe.
 Good deal: A mere $20 for a single knife that'll replace a bevvy of dull slicers? Sign us up!
 $20 at HSN Walmart
 Mintreus Ribbed Knit Loungewear Set 
 $19 $40 Save $21 Save We first came across Mintreus lounge sets thanks to Yahoo reader enthusiasm, and their popularity and prices continue to impress. This pair features a soft ribbed knit with spandex for extra stretch. Unbutton the henley top for breathability or button up for more coverage; the pants have an adjustable drawstring waist and two pockets for stowing essentials. You can run errands or kick back on the couch, and men's sizes let the fellas get in on the comfy fun, too.
 Great time to buy:  Most of us are about to spend a whole lot more time indoors, and what's better for cozying up than a comfortable lounge set? At $19 — more than half off — now's a good time to grab one before the temperatures really plummet. And with all 15 women's colors (and seven men's colors ) on sale, you can find something for anyone on your Nice List deserving of a little extra TLC.
 $19 at Walmart The Home Depot
 Milwaukee M18 Brushless Cordless Battery Powered Leaf Blower 
 $199 $569 Save $370 Save Still dealing with a ton of fallen leaves — and anticipating doing it all over again next autumn? Grab a quality leaf blower to make this tedious job much easier, like this top-rated fave from the trusted tool experts at Milwaukee. At just under five pounds it's lighter than many competitors, making it a great option for saving strain on your arms and back. You'll get up to 20 minutes of full-throttle leaf-blowing time on a single charge, plenty for cleaning up the debris in your yard (and this unit comes with two batteries, so you can easily switch out if needed). It's also a lot quieter than comparable models, with low noise levels of 54dB(A) similar to a standard dishwasher cycle or the low hum of a refrigerator. Your neighbors will thank you!
 Great time to buy: This unit is currently 65% off, so even if you don't have a ton of leaf cleanup left for this year, next year's wallet will certainly be thanking you come fall.
 $199 at The Home Depot More shopping finds worth your time

 QVC has already kicked off some stellar Black Friday savings , and Senior Writer Ellie Conley has gathered some of the top discounts on offer from big brands like Shark, Cuisinart, KitchenAid and more. And, if you're a first-time shopper, you can snag $20 off any order of $40 or more with code HOLIDAY20 .
